svg.text: Firmware Container & NAND Partition Architecture (upgrade_loader.pkg -> cfig NAND Map)
Verified byte offsets, sizes, SHA-256 checksums, and cfig MTD numbers (mtd1..mtd30) from LE32S5760_V2.011_V0.2.zip
1. Official Distribution Archive: LE32S5760_V2.011_V0.2.zip (285,061,005 B | SHA256: 014e235c...)
-> Extracts: upgrade_loader.pkg (323,840,461 B | SHA256: 219de76d... | Timestamp: 2016-08-03 14:26:04 | CRC32: 0x195275a4)
-> Outer 152-byte header (0x00..0x98) followed sequentially by 16 tagged chunks ([4B Tag | 4B Flags | 4B LE Size | Payload])
2. PKG Sequential Partition Stream (Verified Offsets & SHA-256)
3rdB @ 0x000000a4 | 97,738,752 B | SquashFS + NFSB v2 + dm-bht (23,767 blk)
3rdA @ 0x05d360b0 | 97,738,752 B | Identical Bank A/B SHA256: 48de787e...
roda @ 0x0ba6c0bc | 5,767,168 B | ro_data UBI (RSA PubKeys & AES .key/.iv)
cfig @ 0x0bfec0c8 | 237 B | Partition map (uenv:1 .. Seur:30)
load @ 0x0bfec1c1 | 1,314,592 B | Preloader (0..0xa040) + U-Boot ARM32 + RSA
uenv @ 0x0c12d0ed | 2,384 B | Unstripped ARM ELF .o (board/mt5880 env)
adsp @ 0x0c12da49 | 1,272,368 B | Audio DSP firmware (nand 29)
aqda/pqda | 131KB/11.5MB| Audio Quality (18) & Panel PQ data (17)
rfsB @ 0x0cd8452d | 51,466,240 B | RootFS + NFSB v2 + dm-bht (12,514 blk)
rfsA @ 0x0fe99539 | 51,466,240 B | Identical Bank A/B SHA256: e7273462...
kerB @ 0x12fae545 | 2,638,124 B | uImage (HW-LZHS Linux 3.0.13) + dual RSA-2048
kerA @ 0x1323267d | 2,638,124 B | Identical Bank A/B SHA256: dd670a54...
usig (512 B @ 0x134b67b5) + chtD (65KB, nand 28) + chtC (65KB, nand 27)
cfig also allocates game(14), ddb(26), Seur(30) not packed as blobs in PKG
Note: 3rdw (mtd12 /3rd_rw) is declared in cfig (nand 12) and formatted
cleanly on-device as UBIFS; absent from initial PKG image stream.
3. Verified On-Device NAND Mapping (cfig -> mtdblock* & Mounts)
Boot, Kernel & RootFS Banks (cfig Verified: nand 1,4,5,6,7)
mtd1 (uenv) | mtd4 (kerA) & mtd5 (kerB) -> LZHS uImage + dual RSA-2048
mtd6 (rfsA) & mtd7 (rfsB) -> SquashFS + NFSB v2 + dm-bht -> / (ro)
Dual Application Partition (/3rd — mtd9 & mtd10 dm-verity)
mtd9 (3rdA) / mtd10 (3rdB) -> dmsetup create dm-1 --table "0 0 verity ..."
Mount target: /dev/mapper/dm-1 -> /3rd (Opera, Qt, Netflix, Ginga, DIAL)
Persistent State & Read-Only Key Store (mtd11 & mtd13 UBIFS)
mtd11 (perm) -> ubiattach -m 11 -d 2 -> ubi2:perm -> /perm (RW)
mtd13 (ro_data) -> ubiattach -m 13 -d 3 -> ubi3:ro_data -> /ro_data (RO)
Writable Overlay Target: mtd12 (3rdw -> /3rd_rw UBIFS)
ubiattach /dev/ubi_ctrl -m 12 -d 4 -> mount -t ubifs ubi4:3rd_rw /3rd_rw
NO NFSB / NO dm-verity check at mount time! Persistent across reboots.
dtv_svc preserves /3rd_rw/nettv if /3rd_rw/upgrade/customer_version exists.
Calibration & Cross-Verification Metrics (100% Checked)
Additional cfig regions: mtd14(game), 17(pqda), 18(aqda), 26(ddb), 27-30
Factory A/B Mirrors: kerA==kerB, rfsA==rfsB, 3rdA==3rdB (100% bit-identical)
dm-bht Merkle Tree : rfsA=12,514 blocks | 3rdA=23,767 blocks (36,281 PASS)
Safe RW delivery : TAG=smth, METHOD=FILE -> extracts tgz into /3rd_rw
